name: Iwaki Ryuuji
source:
Born on February 20, 1990.
Has a distinctive shaved head. He has an aggressive personality and bullies [url=/c136007]Kita Kenta[/url], but his lack of remorse makes him unpopular with his classmates. He shows a kinder side when caring for his sickly little sister. His henchmen are Masayoshi and Kattsun.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/3年B組金八先生_伝説の教壇に立て!]Wikipedia[/url]]
